approval_scope: Independent static inspection of six J.J. source drawings and fourteen indexed SMS PNGs. Identity, materials and equipment are reviewed; source/support registration and Social reference colors require bounded corrections. This is not continuous motion, hardware, owner, ROM or production approval.
conclusion: Preserve the current J.J. drawings. Identity and material separation work; no whole-character regeneration is justified. Resolve horizontal support registration, freeze the exact prior Social material mapping, and address the reported S04 advanced-pulse budget failure. Then present normal-speed motion for owner judgment.

identity_and_face.note: All six source drawings retain short blue hair, youthful lean physique, magenta uniform/scarf, white armor, diagonal navy harness/holster and white/navy/orange Zillion pistol. Face direction is rightward; SMS expression detail simplifies.

pose_anatomy_and_joint_continuity.note: Shoulders seat under armor; elbows, forearms and wrists remain connected. S01 brings the gun inward; S02 extends the aiming chain; S03/S04 keep that chain; S05 lowers it. Source two-hand support is overlapped and becomes a merged skin/armor cluster in SMS, so finger-level clarity is not claimed.

hand_weapon_attachment.note: Warm hand mass contacts the dark grip in all source poses. Barrel and inset remain coherent in S02-S04. No detached pistol or visibly substituted weapon. The second support hand is less distinguishable in SMS and remains an owner native-size judgment.

equipment_geometry.note: Shoulder/forearm/knee/boot armor, clasp, belt, holster and pistol remain attached and identifiable. Pulse is a deliberately detached effect, not accidental orphan noise. No vehicle or extra weapon is introduced.

pixel_clusters.note: Red cloth masses and white/gray armor planes dominate. Fine edge/detail clusters remain, but no broad grain/dither or whole-sheet texture defect was observed that justifies a rerender. This is a visual judgment, not a quantitative cluster gate.

face_detail_readability.note: Hair silhouette and gaze survive the source reduction; SMS loses iris/mouth microdetail. No expressivity equivalence to the large concept is claimed.

outline_and_cutout.note: Dark/light nearest inspection shows complete J.J. body, boots and pistol with transparent margins; no blocking detached character component observed visually. The two pulse components are intentional. Formal material/cutout gate remains separate.

material_shading.note: J.J. magenta cloth, neutral armor, blue/navy hair/harness and warm skin stay distinguishable in both orientations. Pistol orange inset has a valid material role.

material_shadow_flow_coherence.note: J.J. armor planes and cloth fold/shadow masses are spatially coherent. Fine shadows simplify in SMS. Hair highlights shift to cyan under shared P1; this is a visible color compromise, not an observed isolated light leak in cloth.

semantic_palette_role_confinement.note: J.J. white/warm/blue accents stay inside named materials, but the frozen Social comparator is not color-preserved:34pixels per face change skin-shadow RGB(170,85,85) to magenta(170,0,85). See B03.

frame_pose_integrity.note: The planted-feet/root-stationary proposal is not yet established: corresponding support intervals move laterally between drawings. Much displacement affects both feet together, suggesting source root registration; static coordinates do not prove perceived sliding. See B01.

native_size_readability.note: J.J. reads as a sci-fi gun user with red suit, blue hair and white armor; aiming, emitting and lowered weapon silhouettes differ. Trigger/fingers/eye detail is reduced and one-tick pulse visibility has not been judged in motion.

roster_harmony.note: The paired contour/cluster language is visually coherent and J.J./Social guard opaque heights are both59px, but Social color regression B03 must close before calling the comparator preserved.

production_scale_contract.note: Guard opaque total59px includes hair; S03-S05 total56px. This does not establish the GDD nominal68-72px anatomical target. Do not enlarge only J.J. or claim production scale. The diagnostic common-scale comparison is a narrower scope.

continuous_motion.note: Only stills perceived. Intention, force, pulse persistence, recovery, material flicker or sliding over time cannot be approved from ordered poses or metadata.

ROM_hardware_FPS_PAL_owner.note: Reviewer ran no build/emulator/packing/simulator or performance measurements. Coordinator reports minimum9sprites/line for S04. No ROM, FPS, VBlank, audio, PAL, competitive, owner or delivery claim.

findings.summary: Sole coordinates move laterally despite the proposed planted-feet/root-stationary contract.
findings.observed: Left SMS sole last3rows: idle22..27/48..57; S01same; S0220..25/48..56; S0322..28/50..59; S0421..26/48..57; S0519..24/47..55. Source last3row support bands also move substantially together, with some boot-shape/stance-width variation.
findings.impact: Normal playback may read as root/foot jitter. This report establishes coordinate change only, not perceived sliding.
findings.hypothesis: A fixed source pivotX for drawings whose roots differ accounts for much of the shift.
findings.required_delta: Measure/register horizontal root from both boot contacts per pose using existing pixels and common scale. Inspect residual stance differences in both facings. Only revise a responsible pose if support/roll remains inconsistent after registration. Holds cannot repair a contact-geometry defect.

findings.scope: S04 advanced laser pulse with Social pair
findings.summary: Coordinator reports minimum9sprites/scanline after grid search.
findings.observed: S04 visibly places the single pulse farther beyond the muzzle. The9-sprite minimum is coordinator-supplied evidence, not an independently measured hardware result from this reviewer.
findings.impact: The pair cannot be promoted as legal until canonical packer/line checks pass. The pulse is intentional, so generic orphan cleanup is inappropriate.
findings.hypothesis: An effect-only intervention can remove the extra occupied interval while preserving body, grip, weapon, supports and scale.
findings.required_delta: Keep the control. Investigate changing/removing only the departed S04 pulse, or shortening/repositioning only the effect while preserving the straight single-shot reading. S03 emission followed by an absent/out-of-sample pulse is a coherent proposed portrayal. Recompute both facings and judge normal playback. Do not distort the pistol, shrink one pose or omit renderer cells.

findings.scope: Social reference PNG in each facing
findings.summary: New shared P1 remaps34existing Social pixels to magenta.
findings.observed: New vs prior Hayato timing_only_v7 reference: opaque mask and position equal;34indices change6→14, RGB170/85/85→170/0/85, in each facing.
findings.impact: The declared preserved comparator has changed its skin-shadow color; coexistence cannot claim unchanged Social.
findings.hypothesis: Introducing a code into a previously unused palette slot changes nearest-source mapping even when old visible PLTE slots remain intact.
findings.required_delta: Freeze the source Social material-index→P1 mapping explicitly using the official adapter. Keep source, indices/visible colors and scale unchanged; verify the resulting whole reference index/RGBA arrays against the old baseline. Do not recolor the converted PNG through a second path.

findings.summary: Single shot, body settling and recovery need continuous native-size judgment.
findings.observed: SMS crown top moves22→24 between aim and emission while sole bottom stays80; S05 lowers the gun. The barrel remains horizontal in the static frames.
findings.required_delta: After technical/static blockers close, present exact normal/slow source and real-ROM media. If the owner sees unintended re-aim, second shot or root dip, correct the responsible pose. Do not infer that defect from stills or add frames automatically.

findings.summary: Face and supporting-hand detail reduce; blue-violet source hair highlights become cyan in P1.
findings.required_delta: Present the exact native result against source/concept and Social. This requires owner judgment, not automatic palette growth or full rerender.
